candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes classic mycosis fungoides features (chronic epidermotropic T-cell lymphoma with patch/plaque/erythroderma progression, epidermotropism, band-like infiltrate, CD3+/CD45RO+ tumor cells). 'Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD4-negative' is the broader parent entity encompassing multiple subtypes (MF, Sézary syndrome, primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic T-cell lymphoma, etc.) and does not resolve to the specific benchmark diagnosis of mycosis fungoides.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is the parent category; CD4-negative qualifier adds immunophenotypic detail but does not specify mycosis fungoides as the subtype

case_quality_flags: Unusual CD4-/CD8- double-negative immunophenotype in an otherwise classic MF presentation; reference diagnosis of mycosis fungoides is supported by clinical course and histology despite atypical IHC
